title: Switch Frame Tap
description: Stream gameplay and audio to a PC without a capture card.
author: TomasUribe
details:
Switch Frame Tap is a sysmodule for streaming gameplay and audio to a PC over USB or the network. It uses the H.264 encoder and supports up to 1080p60fps where available.

It supports native-resolution screenshots, recording through the PC viewer, network streaming, and USB webcam mode.

A reboot is required after installation or updating so the sysmodule can restart.
changelog:
v0.7.18.1

**v0.7.18.1: homebrew docked mode from forwarders**

- **Homebrew in docked mode (beta) now works from forwarders too.** Homebrew started from a forwarder on the HOME menu (an installed homebrew title with its own title id, as sphaira makes them) is told the console is docked, like homebrew started by holding R over a game - so SDL2 ports and emulators draw and stream at 1080p. Forwarders run with a game's memory, so 1080p fits. Forwarders with a Nintendo-style 0100... title id look like games and are left alone; homebrew opened from the Album stays as it is (too little memory there for 1080p).

**Updating:** open the Switch app's **Updates** page (or unzip `switch-frame-tap-0.7.18.1-switch.zip` over the SD card root) and restart the console. Settings are kept. The PC viewers and the Android app offer the update when they open.
